funding_cost_sensitivity.conservative_drag_model: funding is treated as same-direction daily cost drag

promotion_cost_commentary.practical_threshold_note: No-cost headline remains positive, but high-turnover Alpha Zoo is cost fragile; prefer paper/testnet fill measurement before real-money authorization.

cost_sensitivity.trade_return_model: isolated liquidation loss is capped at allocation_fraction; otherwise allocation_fraction * leverage * (gross_return - round_trip_slippage_fee_bps/10000 - funding_bps_per_day/10000*holding_days)

evidence: frozen_train_validation_rank is assigned before locked-OOS gate filtering
locked_oos_gate_pass is computed after ranking and does not change tv_selection_score

selected_contract.max_order_value_policy: disabled unless explicitly positive emergency cap

incumbent_contract_tie_breaker.reason: Current documented live candidate 7x/0.15 has the same train+validation score and 105% notional/equity as the raw grid pick, while preserving the requested isolated margin/equity contract.

selection.selection_policy: freeze all train/validation-feasible strategy/leverage/allocation candidates by validation-primary train+validation score; locked-OOS can only gate candidates after freeze, not alter scores; train+validation ties on the same live strategy/notional contract prefer the documented incumbent live contract

strict_zero_liquidation_lane.promotion_rule: train/validation/locked-OOS liquidation_count must be zero, every split minimum margin buffer must be positive, OOS MDD must stay within 25%, OOS return must beat the current-base reference, and Sharpe/Sortino/smart Sortino/Calmar must be positive. Return/MDD is diagnostic report-only, not a promotion hurdle.
